from difftest import gen_sat, corrupt, gen_random

reqs = []
for i in range(4000):
    r = rng.random()
    if r < 0.5: reqs.append(gen_sat(rng))
    elif r < 0.8: reqs.append(corrupt(rng, gen_sat(rng)))
    else: reqs.append(gen_random(rng))
inp = ''.join(json.dumps(r) + '\n' for r in reqs)
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '/app/main.py'], input=inp, text=True, capture_output=True, cwd='/app')

lines = p.stdout.splitlines()
assert len(lines) == len(reqs)
bad = 0
for req, line in zip(reqs, lines):
    got = json.loads(line)
    if got['order'] is not None and not valid_history(req, got['order']):
        bad += 1
print(f'big batch: {len(reqs)} reqs in {dt:.3f}s, invalid witnesses: {bad}')
